# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta7

## Fixed

- Fix OpenStreetMap being hidden in Multi mower view even though the underlay itself was rendered. The Multi mower renderer no longer paints its opaque map background over the dedicated OSM layer when OpenStreetMap is enabled.
- Re-sync the OSM underlay after Multi mower Site API metadata becomes ready, so a card opened before site metadata finishes loading does not remain without tiles.
- Keep Single mower OpenStreetMap behavior unchanged.

## Compatibility

OpenStreetMap remains opt-in and still requires validated georeference/site data. Existing cards with no underlay configured are unchanged.
